estimates.name: Business Combinations — Acquisition of AWM
estimates.t: In accordance with ASC 805, total consideration was first allocated to the fair value of assets acquired and liabilities assumed, with the excess being recorded as Goodwill.

estimates.name: AWM Earnout Consideration
estimates.t: As of the AWM Closing Date, the AWM Earnout Consideration was estimated to have a fair value of approximately $17.3 million, using a Monte-Carlo simulation method.

estimates.name: Acquisition of APA Solar
estimates.t: In accordance with Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”) Topic 805 Business Combinations (“ASC 805”), total consideration was first allocated to the fair value of assets acquired and liabilities assumed, with the excess being recorded as Goodwill.

estimates.name: APA Earnout Consideration
estimates.t: The APA Earnout Consideration is accounted for as contingent consideration, and the fair value is estimated each reporting period.
